name: Engram design for the final test, fixed on 5 November 2026 before any use of conversations 5 to 9
search: four channel networks (time, place, person, context), each MLP 32 and 16, three starts (seeds 1, 2, 3) averaged
training: conversations 0 to 4 only, evidence labels, up to 8 negatives per positive
facts_position: above the sentences; sentences shown in time order
fact_writer: Gemma 3 4B, hf.co/bartowski/google_gemma-3-4b-it-GGUF:Q4_K_M, at chat close, 700 reply tokens, at most 12 facts per chat
fact_check: engram_facts.parse, minimum word support 0.2, unsupported facts rejected
answer_model: same Gemma 3 4B file, Ollama context 4096, 60 reply tokens, temperature 0, vps_kit.ANSWER prompt
test_questions: all non-adversarial questions with evidence in conversations 5 to 9
comparison: paired, same questions, same search with facts against without facts; current Engram also reported
primary_measure: strict score, blind labels, score4 rules; 95% interval by paired bootstrap; success if the interval stays above zero
secondary: generous score, by question type, evidence found, not mentioned, fact accuracy sample
not_included: search phrases, episode context, 1,500 tokens, any model smaller than Gemma 3 4B
